name: evidence
semantic_rules: Unknown capture time cannot be labeled current without another explicitly valid freshness definition.
A hash verifies referenced bytes only; it does not make an inference true.

name: context_packet
semantic_rules: Authorization must be rechecked at retrieval and publication; a packet is not a transferable grant.

name: consent_proposal
semantic_rules: A design/example record is never a real subject grant.
Health read, partner share, retention and cloud transfer require distinct purpose handling.

name: daily_action_proposal
semantic_rules: The application must define daylight-saving and missed-run semantics before scheduling.
Draft/proposal cannot be shown as a provider-accepted action.

name: health_observation
semantic_rules: UNKNOWN/PROVIDER_ERROR observation must not contain a fabricated numerical value.
Arrival time cannot replace sample time.

name: spatial_estimate
semantic_rules: Unknown uncertainty has no invented numerical parameters.
Transform and time compatibility require semantic validation outside schema.

name: agent_job
semantic_rules: A job lease/budget is not physical authorization; executor policy is separate.
No automatic skill or policy mutation.

name: experiment
semantic_rules: A max trial count is a budget, not statistical evidence that the sample size is adequate.

name: design_artifact
semantic_rules: Future actual artifacts must match their content hash and safe relative path.
Requirement spec is not a toolpath or inspected part.

name: physical_action_proposal
semantic_rules: No arbitrary IP/URI/serial/raw command field is permitted.
Physical executor requires independently validated actual authorization and qualified apparatus.

name: delivery_receipt
semantic_rules: Local storage is neither destination delivery nor responder dispatch.

name: capability_qualification
semantic_rules: External documentation does not qualify the local device or technique.
